    THE HOLLOW MARCHES / YOUR STORYAn original adventure · · Original adventure

    At this table

    An open-world AI dungeon master powered by Groq. You can attempt any fictional action; the world responds with plausible limits and consequences. Your actions and adventure context are sent to Groq to generate each turn.

    • Write freely: negotiate, explore, travel, craft, fight or pursue an entirely new goal. Suggestions are starting points, not limits.
    • The DM sets a check before the server rolls a d20. Ability modifiers, proficiency, advantage and attack criticals are applied in code.
    • Health, spell slots, Second Wind, money, inventory, NPCs and quests carry forward. A successful rest can restore you. Character advancement is narrative; this version keeps level 2 mechanics.
    • Fighters can use Second Wind once, then regain it after a successful short or long rest. Healing potions cannot be consumed at full health.
    • The game summarises older events to keep long campaigns manageable. Important details can occasionally be missed by the AI—remind your DM when needed.
    • Your campaign saves in this browser. Keep using the same device and site address. A save expires after 30 days without a successful turn.
    • This is a simplified, AI-adjudicated 5e-inspired game, not a full tabletop rules simulator. Combat and creative effects are narrated around server-rolled checks.
